# EDMX integration fixtures

The layout follows the CSN tests in this repo and the EDMX tests in overlay-golang:

- Input documents live in testdata/*.edmx.
- Rulesets, baselines, and expected XML live in testdata/integration/.
- Small behavior examples use inline XML in the unit tests beside the processor.

## Coverage

The integration suite has eight cases and 24 fixture files:

- Three cases share full_edmx_envelope.edmx to check exact, prefix, and empty
  annotation allowlists while preserving the complete EDMX structure.
- Five cases check inline/external baseline equivalence, multiple baselines plus
  global rules, bound operation signatures, and nested annotation targets.

The processor unit tests cover pruning, XML content, unresolved targets, block
qualifiers, expressions, and additional model elements. A shared table in
processor_baseline_test.go covers all 12 combinations of inline/external inputs,
inline/external baselines, and unqualified/A/B qualifiers. Five former integration
cases duplicated existing processor unit coverage and were removed.

## Node reference

Expected outputs come from the unchanged Node EDMX PR #5 production modules at
9eada5f8fdb340b70d7173179e8b87fcbd53175c, using saxes@6.0.0. Moving smaller cases
into unit tests retained their reference XML as inline expectations. The two new
shared-envelope outputs were also generated by those same Node modules.

Tests load files with testutils.LoadFixture and compare decoded XML with
testutils.AssertXMLEquals. Differences in escaping, attribute order, and empty-tag
spelling are allowed; changed values or annotation selection fail the tests.
Node is not required to run the Go tests.

To regenerate a snapshot after an intentional compatibility change, run the
corresponding input, ruleset, and baseline files from integration_test.go through
the pinned Node EDMXProcessor and EDMXRuleset modules. Keep the expected output
independent of the Go implementation.

Run the fixture suite with:

    go test -tags integration ./internal/processor/edmx

Run focused processor, resolver, and extractor tests with:

    go test -tags unit ./internal/processor/edmx
